rationale: Bill is building applied ML products around LLM efficiency and real-time perception at General Instinct (YC P26), while Konstantin leads DreamInk in brand entertainment and product placement—a domain where AI-driven personalization and real-time content adaptation could create meaningful value. intro_message: Bill Jiao, meet Konstantin—you're both building at the intersection of AI and consumer-facing products, and there may be interesting applications for real-time AI in entertainment and brand experiences.
